template: Open {{v2}} and sign in with username admin and password admin. Then go to the Contacts app and create a new contact/customer named exactly '{{v3}}' with the City field set to '{{v4}}'. Save the record and verify on the page that the name and city are correct. Important: do not wait for network idle (the app long-polls); wait for concrete page state instead. Any autocomplete fields must have an option actually chosen from the dropdown.

target.selector: body > header > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div > a:nth-of-type(2)
